submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.0044%) at the Sb-rich end (Sb 0.835). XRD shows the same rutile/trirutile-type pattern across the line, with extra reflections (Q about 2.44 and 3.63) appearing in Sb-rich films. EQE was low at mid composition (idx 10: 0.0009%) and negative at idx 21, so idx 28 is the best measured.
